verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll/HR platform (with an embedded API and an MCP dev-assistant server), but there is no evidence of any policy, setting, or documentation addressing whether customer/payroll data is used to train AI models or how a user could opt out. The axis applies since Gusto processes sensitive HR data and offers AI-adjacent tooling (dev assistant MCP), but no AI-training data-use controls or opt-out mechanism are documented. Missing for 10: any privacy policy statement on AI training data use, an opt-out/opt-in control, or documentation of data handling for AI features.
